subject.title: Claude CLI sessions reset on every turn in group channels due to groupIntro drift in extraSystemPromptHash

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker for the Claude CLI false-invalidation family, or should maintainers close/supersede the stale groupIntro PR and move the remaining live-session fingerprint work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/81041?
rationale: Automation can see that current main fixes the title binding-level trigger and that a narrower live-fingerprint tracker remains open, but it should not decide the canonical tracker split while an open PR still uses closing syntax for this issue.

options.title: Keep Open As Canonical
options.body: Leave this issue open until the stale groupIntro PR is resolved and the live-fingerprint work has either landed or been explicitly split.

options.title: Split And Close Later
options.body: Close or retarget the stale groupIntro PR, confirm the remaining scope belongs to the narrower live-session issue, then close this issue with links to the current-main fixes and the canonical follow-up.

options.title: Adopt Broad Fix
options.body: Keep this issue as the landing target for a broader repair that also resolves the live-session fingerprint path instead of using the narrower tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep Open As Canonical
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the stale groupIntro PR is resolved and the live-fingerprint work has either landed or been explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the most recent merged binding-level fixes in this issue family and are the strongest current-main routing signal.
